page_title: CHE 2-2 BUR | Chelsea v Burnley 30/03/2024, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+6' There will be no more action in this match as the referee signals full time.
90+5' Chelsea take the corner, but their hopes of scoring a goal end with a nice clearance by the defence.
90+2' Darren England shows a yellow card to Maxime Esteve (Burnley) for his blatant foul.
90' 5 additional min. will be played.
89' Jay Rodriguez (Burnley) misses a rebound from the penalty spot. The ball flies just a few inches over the bar.
89' CHANCE! Jay Rodriguez (Burnley) rises high to meet the resultant corner kick and attempts to steer his fine header past the goalkeeper, but only hits the crossbar!
88' The ball is out of play and the linesman points at the corner flag. Corner to Burnley.
88' The ball goes out for a corner. Burnley can continue in their attacking effort.
88' Malo Gusto (Chelsea) has picked up a minor injury, but it looks like he will be able to continue.
87' The referee stops play so that a substitution can be made and Malo Gusto trots off the pitch and is replaced by Alfie Gilchrist (Chelsea).
86' The game is interrupted now, Malo Gusto (Chelsea) picks up a knock and the physio has to come on.
85' Cole Palmer swings the cross over. Raheem Sterling (Chelsea) gets his head to it but it goes just wide of the right post.
82' The referee and his assistant both point at the corner flag. Burnley will have an opportunity to threaten the opposition's goal.
81' 2 - 2 The resulting corner is whipped in by Josh Cullen and Dara O'Shea (Burnley) is left unmarked to plant a precise header into the top of the net. The score is 2:2.
80' Burnley are awarded a free kick from mid-range. The position is unsuitable for a direct shot, so expect a cross into the box.

78' 2 - 1 Goal! Raheem Sterling displays great vision and sends a pass to Cole Palmer (Chelsea), who shows brilliant composure inside the box to bury the ball into the bottom right corner. The score is 2:1.
75' Cole Palmer (Chelsea) picks up a pass and has an effort from the edge of the box, but Arijanet Muric gets down to his right to keep it out.
73' The referee signals that it is time for a substitution and Raheem Sterling (Chelsea) comes onto the pitch so that Moises Caicedo can be given a rest.
73' The flag goes up and the referee blows his whistle - another offside by Nicolas Jackson (Chelsea), who has already been caught several times today.
70' Vincent Kompany has decided to make a change. Johann Berg Gudmundsson (Burnley) replaces Wilson Odobert.
70' A pass finds the feet of Noni Madueke (Chelsea) on the edge of the box and he sends in a low shot towards the middle of the goal, but it's easily gathered by the goalkeeper.
69' Substitution. Lyle Foster did his best and is replaced by Jay Rodriguez (Burnley).
68' Mykhailo Mudryk (Chelsea) was too fierce in his attempt to get the ball from his opponent and Darren England blows for a foul. Burnley earn a free kick.
65' Mykhailo Mudryk (Chelsea) finds space on the edge of the box, but his wild shot goes high over the bar.

63' Nicolas Jackson (Chelsea) receives a precise pass in the box and takes the shot early. The ball heads towards the bottom left corner, but Arijanet Muric shows off his skills and makes a brilliant save to deny him.
62' Substitution. Noni Madueke (Chelsea) replaces Conor Gallagher.
62' Chelsea can’t profit from the corner as the defence clear the ball upfield.

61' Mykhailo Mudryk (Chelsea) steps up to take the corner. He launches the ball into the penalty area, but it only finds the head of an opposing player who clears the danger. The ball goes behind for a corner. Chelsea will have an opportunity to threaten the opposition's goal.
60' Chelsea will have a chance to score from a corner kick.

60' Mykhailo Mudryk (Chelsea) received a pass inside the box and sent a dangerous shot in on goal, but keep the champagne on ice as one of the defenders stepped in and blocked the effort. It's hard to say whether the keeper would have stopped it. The ball goes out of play. Chelsea are awarded a corner kick.
58' Lyle Foster (Burnley) escapes his marker to meet a cross and heads to the middle of the goal, but the keeper pulls off an excellent reflex save to deny him.
56' Arijanet Muric displays his ability to read the game and clears the danger after Marc Cucurella (Chelsea) threatened to latch onto a through ball from just outside the box.
55' Chelsea have been awarded a corner kick. The referee and one of his assistants both point at the corner flag.
55' Marc Cucurella (Chelsea) tries to slide the ball through to a teammate but it's well blocked by a defender. The linesman makes the right call and Chelsea will have a corner.
51' The Chelsea players keep the ball and are exchanging a combination of passes. They are waiting for gaps in the defence to open up.

47' 1 - 1 It's in the back of the net! Josh Cullen (Burnley) produces a brilliant first-time effort from the edge of the penalty area after receiving the ball from Josh Brownhill. The goalkeeper would need to possess super powers to stop this shot from reaching the right side of the goal.
46' Half-time substitution. Vincent Kompany decided to make a change. Jacob Bruun Larsen is replaced by Josh Brownhill (Burnley).
46' The second half gets underway.
45+8' Darren England has ended the first half by blowing the whistle.
45+7' Chelsea take a short corner instead of sending the ball into the penalty area.

45+6' Arijanet Muric pulls off a great save to deny Malo Gusto (Chelsea), who makes himself some space inside the box and unleashes a quick shot to the right side of the goal. Corner kick. Chelsea will have an opportunity.
45+3' Josh Cullen (Burnley) makes a bad challenge on his opponent and is booked by the referee.
45+1' Conor Gallagher (Chelsea) is booked after bringing down an opponent. Darren England had an easy-decision to make.
45' We are about to witness a substitution. Charlie Taylor (Burnley) is replacing Zeki Amdouni.
45' There will be a minimum of 7 min. of added time.
44' 1 - 0 Goal! Cole Palmer (Chelsea) puts the ball into the middle of the goal past the outstretched arm of Arijanet Muric.
44' Cole Palmer (Chelsea) is heading towards the penalty spot to take it.
43' Referee Darren England has finally had enough of Vincent Kompany and gives him a straight RED CARD!
43' The penalty decision stands after the VAR review. It's a penalty!
42' There's some confusion. Looks like the ref is going to review the penalty decision to Chelsea using VAR. Let's see what happens.
40' Lorenz Assignon (Burnley) receives a yellow card from Darren England and because it's his second he will have an early bath.
40' Darren England blows for a foul after Lorenz Assignon (Burnley) was too aggressive in the battle for the ball. PENALTY to Chelsea! Let's see who will take responsibility.
39' Great ball in from Wilson Odobert. Jacob Bruun Larsen (Burnley) should really have done better with a close-range header, but he heads it a whisker wide of the left post.
38' The linesman signals that Nicolas Jackson (Chelsea) is offside and the referee confirms the decision.
37' Mykhailo Mudryk (Chelsea) puts a dangerous cross into the box, but the corner is cleared by the first man.
37' Jacob Bruun Larsen (Burnley) strikes the ball goalwards from a mid-range free kick, but his effort only goes towards the middle of the goal and presents no problem for the goalkeeper.
35' This yellow card was deserved. The tackle by Marc Cucurella (Chelsea) was quite harsh and Darren England didn't hesitate to show him a yellow card.

34' This was a piece of cake for Arijanet Muric. Mykhailo Mudryk (Chelsea) found himself some space after latching on to a pass, but his strike only went low to the middle of the goal and into the gloves of the prepared keeper.
31' A pass by Jacob Bruun Larsen (Burnley) ends up in no man's land, and the attacking effort comes to an end.
29' Cole Palmer (Chelsea) gets on the end of a good pass and from mid-range he unleashes a decent strike, but the shot is blocked by the defender.

26' A sweet pass finds Josh Cullen (Burnley) on the edge of the box, and he drills the ball towards the bottom right corner. Djordje Petrovic is almost caught out but pulls off a brilliant save at the last second.
24' Here comes the VAR verdict. NO GOAL for Chelsea due to a handball in the build-up play.
22' Hold on! There’s a VAR review to see whether there was a handball in the build up to the goal. The referee is checking now. The Chelsea players aren’t happy.
21' The ball goes out of play and Chelsea have been awarded a corner kick.
20' Goal! Axel Disasi (Chelsea) ran onto a clever lofted pass from Mykhailo Mudryk and easily beat the keeper with a header into the right side of the goal from close range. 1:0.
20' A cross into the box from Mykhailo Mudryk (Chelsea) is cleared. The ball is out of play. Chelsea will have a chance to score from a corner.
20' Chelsea have a corner.
20' The corner is swung in but Chelsea can’t take advantage as a defender sweeps the ball away. The ball goes out of play. Chelsea are awarded a corner kick.

19' Nicolas Jackson (Chelsea) produced a promising shot low towards the middle of the goal after his wonderful solo run, but Arijanet Muric thwarted him with a fabulous save and the score remains the same. Good work from Chelsea as they win a corner.
18' Cole Palmer (Chelsea) expertly controls the pass inside the penalty area and shoots, but it's inadvertently blocked a defender.
16' Lorenz Assignon (Burnley) is booked.
15' A good clearance by a defender means the corner comes to nothing for Chelsea.

15' Wilson Odobert (Burnley) dribbles his way to the edge of the box and drills a shot towards the top right corner, but Djordje Petrovic is equal to the effort and makes a good save. Burnley have been awarded a corner kick.
14' Darren England has a clear sight and sees a foul from Cole Palmer (Chelsea). Burnley are awarded a free kick. Let's see what they create from this.
12' A decent cross into the box is met first time by Enzo Fernandez (Chelsea), but his powerful goalbound effort is superbly blocked by a defender.
11' Chelsea win a corner.
11' Chelsea have a chance to score from a corner kick, but the ball is cleared by a defender. The ball is out of play and Chelsea manage to earn a corner.

10' Enzo Fernandez (Chelsea) gets inside the box and tries to beat Arijanet Muric with a measured shot towards the roof of the net, but the keeper is equal to the effort and makes a fine save. The referee signals a corner kick to Chelsea.
9' What a huge chance for Jacob Bruun Larsen (Burnley). He collects a precise pass inside the box and slices a shot that goes a whisker wide of the left post.
6' A quickly taken corner by Burnley.

6' Jacob Bruun Larsen (Burnley) elects to shoot from the edge of the box instead of sending the free kick into the box, but the defensive wall manages to block the shot. Wasted opportunity! Burnley force a corner. They send men into the box.
4' Conor Gallagher (Chelsea) commits a rough foul. Darren England stops the game and makes a call. Burnley are awarded a free kick from a dangerous position.
3' Wilson Odobert (Burnley) tries to send a pass but it's blocked.
2' Cole Palmer (Chelsea) has a chance after receiving a pass. He measures his shot from the edge of the box but it sails just wide of the left post.
1' Today's match has just started, enjoy the game!
Burnley will kick the game off.
Darren England got the nomination for today's game and will try his best to be a fair judge and not make any mistakes.
